veranderings.voor: pak wat 'n mens se eie lug saamdra
veranderings.na: pak waarin 'n mens sy eie lug saamdra
veranderings.rede: As written the suit itself carries the air; 'waarin ... sy eie lug saamdra' matches the study text, where the person carries the air in the suit.

veranderings.blok: Hoe die Maan se oppervlak lyk
veranderings.rede: 'rondlê' suggests things lying scattered about carelessly; 'lê oral' says plainly that the dust is everywhere.
